output.reason: PMK 66/2023 governs benefits in kind (natura/kenikmatan) received by employees, including permanent employees. It classifies these benefits as income subject to PPh and sets the exclusions, e.g. meal coupons up to Rp2,000,000 per month and benefits in remote areas. It also sets the valuation rules (market value or cost) and requires the employer to withhold PPh 21 from July 2023, with the January–June 2023 period excluded from withholding. These provisions change the gross income base used in the PPh 21 calculation for permanent employees.
